YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.title: Pig Pig
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.pages.INITIAL.descript: A pig appears before you. It seems to want to give you something...
Choose one relic from 3 random relics.
Choose up to 3 cards to upgrade.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.firstVisitEver.0-: Oink oink... Stranger, you have entered my domain.
I am Pig Pig, guardian of this land. Let me see what I can do for you...
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.anci: Oink, warrior... Your sword is stained with blood.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.IRONCLAD.0-1.anci: But I know it's to protect those dear to you. Let me help you.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0.anci: We meet again, warrior. Your power seems to have grown.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.IRONCLAD.1-1.anci: Continue forward, I will be watching over you.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.IRONCLAD.2-1.anci: Let me give you some more help, I hope you can go further.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancien: Oink, hunter... You are always so quiet.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.SILENT.0-1.ancien: But your blades never show mercy. Let me see what I can give you.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.SILENT.1-0.ancien: We meet again, hunter. Silence is your weapon.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.SILENT.1-1.ancien: But sometimes, accepting help is also a form of wisdom.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancien: Hunter, your figure is like a ghost.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.SILENT.2-1.ancien: Let me provide you with something useful.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancien: Oink, robot... Your existence intrigues me.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.DEFECT.0-1.ancien: Without a soul, why do you climb the spire? Let me give you something.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.DEFECT.1-0.ancien: We meet again, robot. You seem to be searching for something.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.DEFECT.1-1.ancien: Perhaps the answer lies ahead, continue your journey.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancien: Robot, your logic is always so perfect.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.DEFECT.2-1.ancien: But sometimes, intuition is more important than calculation. Take this.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.REGENT.0-0.ancien: Oink, noble... Your aura is different from others.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.REGENT.0-1.ancien: Noble bloodline doesn't guarantee safety, let me help you.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.REGENT.1-0.ancien: We meet again, noble. Your elegance is impressive.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.REGENT.1-1.ancien: But true power comes from within, not from without.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.REGENT.2-0.ancien: Noble, your determination commands my respect.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.REGENT.2-1.ancien: Let me provide you with some help, continue your journey.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.NECROBINDER.0-0.a: Oink, necromancer... The power of death flows through you.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.NECROBINDER.0-1.a: But life and death are equally precious, let me give you something.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0.a: We meet again, necromancer. Your pact with death runs deep.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.NECROBINDER.1-1.a: But sometimes, living requires more courage than dying.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.NECROBINDER.2-1.a: Let me give you some help, may you find balance between life and death.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.ANY.3-1r.ancient: You remind me of a friend from long ago.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.ANY.4-0r.ancient: Danger lurks everywhere in the spire...
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.ANY.4-1r.ancient: But you have the strength to overcome it.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.ANY.6-1r.ancient: You seem to have grown stronger.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.ANY.7-1r.ancient: Let me give you something useful.
YUWANCARD-PIG_PIG.talk.ANY.9-1r.ancient: I sense the scent of success.
DARV.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: So many gems... but can I eat them?
DARV.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: These gems aren't for eating, but they can make you stronger! Choose one, little pig!
DARV.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancient: Oink! Still hesitating? Take your time, the gems aren't going anywhere!
DARV.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: I have many good things here, but I don't seem to have the carrot you want...
DARV.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Carrot! Do you know carrot? That's pig's favorite thing!
[i][font_size=22]Pig's eyes light up.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: Well, no carrots, but these gems might help you find more delicious things!
NEOW.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: Who are you? Are you here to bring pig food?
NEOW.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char: Pig wants... delicious food! And... to become stronger! So pig can protect the delicious food!
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: Wow! You're so pretty! Shiny like gold!
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: Oh my, cute little pig! Let me make you even prettier!
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancien: Come come! Let me give you some shiny good things!
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: You're so cute, you deserve the best decorations!
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Thank you! Pig will treasure it!
[i][font_size=22]Pig happily spins around.[/font_size][/i]
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: Good piggy! Go now, adventure with my blessings!
OROBAS.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: You're interesting too!! Little pig!! Want to play together!!
OROBAS.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancient: Oink oink!! You can oink too!! We're friends!!
OROBAS.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: Giving you things!! Delicious things!! Or shiny things!!
OROBAS.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Pig wants both! Is that okay?
[i][font_size=22]Pig looks at OROBAS with expectant eyes.[/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: Okay!! All for you!! You're the best pig friend!!
PAEL.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: You look sleepy... pig is sleepy too...
PAEL.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Then let's sleep together for a while... find delicious things in dreams...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Giving you a sweet dream... with endless carrots...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Really?! Pig loves dreaming!
[i][font_size=22]Pig happily wags its tail.[/font_size][/i]
PAEL.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: [thinky_dots]Go... eat your fill in dreams before waking...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: You're fierce! But pig isn't afraid! Pig is strong!
TANX.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: [b]Good!! Brave!! Take this weapon!! Go fight!![/b]
TANX.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancient: [b]Little pig must fight too!! Get stronger!! Protect yourself!![/b]
TANX.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: [b]What weapon do you want?! Great sword?! Or shield?![/b]
TANX.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Pig wants... a weapon that can protect friends!
[i][font_size=22]Pig puffs out its chest.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: [b]Good!! That's a true warrior!! Take it!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: Come in little pig! Let me warm you! It's very comfortable here!
TEZCATARA.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancien: You look like you need rest! Come, lie by the fire for a while!
TEZCATARA.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: Giving you some [jitter][b]warm power[/b][/jitter]! So you can stay warm in the cold tower!
TEZCATARA.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Thank you! Pig feels so warm!
[i][font_size=22]Pig comfortably squints its eyes.[/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: Go! Continue forward with this warmth!
VAKUU.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: You look mysterious... are you good or bad?
VAKUU.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: Me? I'm just... a trader. What do you want?
VAKUU.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancient: Little pig, what do you have to trade?
VAKUU.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: I can give you power... but you need to pay a price.
VAKUU.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Pig... can give you oinks! That's pig's most precious thing!
[i][font_size=22]Pig thinks seriously.[/font_size][/i]
VAKUU.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: ...Interesting. Fine, take this power. Your innocence impresses me.
PIG_PIG.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0.char: You're... a pig?! I'm a pig too!
PIG_PIG.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1.ancient: Oink! Welcome, fellow pig! I've been waiting for so long!
PIG_PIG.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.ancient: You're finally here! I've prepared many good things for you!
PIG_PIG.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0.ancient: Choose one! All pig-exclusive good things!
PIG_PIG.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1.char:
Wow! All things pig likes! Thank you piggy senior!
[i][font_size=22]Pig happily wags its tail.[/font_size][/i]
PIG_PIG.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2.ancient: Go! Let everyone know the power of pigs! Oink!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-0r.an: You stand here, yet seem to be nowhere. What are you looking for? Gold? Carrots? Or a door that won't open?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-1r.ch: Pig... is waiting for delicious food. Before getting delicious food, pig goes nowhere.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.0-2r.an: Door? You never needed one. You're just afraid of "pushing it open only to find nothing inside."
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-0r.an: You're back again. The tower is like a feeding trough to you—you can't finish it because you don't want to.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-1r.ch: The trough is good. Empty is bad. Empty means... nothing to eat.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.1-2r.an: Foolish. If you don't finish, you'll never taste the next dish.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-0r.an: Then stand there. The tower will remember for you: you came, many times, but ate nothing.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-1r.ch:
What did pig eat... that makes pig stop waiting?
[i][font_size=22]Pig tilts its head in confusion.[/font_size][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUWANCARD-PIG.2-2r.an: It will. So don't eat. Keep starving—hunger is your only reliable compass.
